name: folio
description: Desktop app and MCP server for rigorous, auditable tabular document review workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Tabular document review with AI via local MCP
interface.longDescription: Folio helps teams run high-stakes document review workflows locally, then expose tools through MCP for auditable AI-assisted retrieval, classification, and extraction.
defaultPrompt: Install Folio and connect its MCP server in this environment.
Set up a criteria-based search workflow for this document set.
Build a repeatable sensemaking pipeline for due diligence.
